fundamentals.name: ProShares Ultra VIX Short-Term Futures ETF
fundamentals.longBusinessSummary: The index seeks to offer exposure to market volatility through publicly traded futures markets and is designed to measure the implied volatility of the S&P 500 over 30 days in the future.

news.paragraph: UVXY is a leveraged volatility ETF designed for uncertain times, often used as a hedging tool. However, recent analysis suggests that its leveraged strategy may not be sustainable in the long term, implying that "good things do not last" for this product. Its utility as a short-term tactical play or hedge is highlighted, but investors are cautioned against long-term holding due to the nature of leveraged volatility products.
